titulo: NASA Sets Coverage for SpaceX 35th Station Resupply Launch, Arrival
cuerpo: NASA and SpaceX are targeting 6:33 a.m. EDT, Tuesday, Oct. 13, for the next launch to deliver science investigations, supplies, and equipment, including the final set of International Space Station Roll-Out Solar Arrays, to the space station.
